summary: Sandbach United kick off their 2026/27 campaign against Stafford Town in what promises to be a competitive match between two sides that have threatened the play-offs in recent seasons. The opening day of the league season is always unpredictable, with new signings and fresh ambitions on display across the NWCFL, so it should be a fascinating afternoon at the ground. Admission is just £6 for adults, £5 for concessions, and £2 for under-16s.
